svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 16 — "Learning When Not to Ask" — Section 3 closes
svg.desc: Page 16: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full / half-half / full). Section 3 closes. Surface-level reunion: Luma stands on Theodore's knee, dust head to foot, scanner data hovering. "It was... informative." She lifts her lenses onto her forehead — vulnerable without mediation — composing herself, declaring she must speak with the Captain. Theodore lifts her gently to his waistcoat pocket: "Steady. / Steady." Final beat: he looks back over his shoulder at the dark grate as he leaves through a doorway. CAPTION: He was learning when not to ask.
